html:
Visit a pearl farm to learn about the culture and process of pearl cultivation on Phu Quoc Island. Continue to the Sim Wine Factory to discover how local sim wine and products are produced, with opportunities to sample and taste them.

Stop at a local pepper farm to learn about different types of peppercorns and traditional farming methods. Visit a fish sauce factory to understand how this essential ingredient in Vietnamese cuisine is made.

Travel uphill to Ho Quoc Pagoda, a peaceful Buddhist temple overlooking the sea. Enjoy lunch at Sao Beach, followed by free time to relax, swim, and sunbathe on one of Phu Quoc’s most beautiful beaches.

Visit Coconut Tree Prison, a historical relic from the French Colonial period and the Vietnam War. End the tour with a walking visit to Sunset Town, featuring Mediterranean-style architecture, the Clock Tower, and the Kiss Bridge, offering stunning panoramic sea views.

ITINERARY

08:45 – 09:00

Pick-up at hotels in Duong Dong Ward.

Guests staying outside Duong Dong Ward are kindly requested to contact us in advance.

Pearl Farm

Learn about the history and techniques of pearl farming on Phu Quoc Island.

Sim Wine Factory

Discover the production of local sim wine and sim-based products.

Local Pepper Farm

Visit a family-run pepper garden and learn about pepper harvesting.

Fish Sauce Factory

Learn about the traditional process of producing Phu Quoc fish sauce.

Ho Quoc Pagoda

Visit a scenic Buddhist temple located on the hillside overlooking the sea.

Sao Beach

Enjoy lunch and free time for relaxing, swimming, and sunbathing.

Coconut Tree Prison

Visit the historical war museum and prison site.

15:30

Check-in at Sunset Town.

Walking tour to explore the Kiss Bridge, Clock Tower, and surrounding areas.

On the way back, guests may choose to stop at Sunset Sanato or the Night Market in Duong Dong Town.

Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense.

16:30

Return to your hotel.

TOUR PRICE

Without Lunch

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 10 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 6 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

With Lunch

  • Adults (from 10 years old): 20 USD per person

  • Children (from 5 to 9 years old): 10 USD per child

  • Children under 5 years old: Free of charge

TOUR INCLUDES

  • Round-trip transportation by air-conditioned car

  • English-speaking tour guide

  • One bottle of drinking water per guest

  • Set menu lunch (if booked in advance)

Special meal requests such as vegan, vegetarian, or children’s meals must be informed at the time of booking or at least twenty-four hours before departure.

TOUR EXCLUDES

  • Personal expenses not mentioned in the inclusions

  • Entrance ticket to Kiss Bridge

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Guests who wish to stop at Sunset Sanato or the Night Market in Duong Dong Ward on the way back should inform the tour guide in advance. Entrance tickets and return transportation are at guests’ own expense.

  • Guests are advised to bring towels, spare clothes, swimwear, comfortable shoes or flip-flops, and some cash.

CHILDREN’S PRICING POLICY

  • Children aged ten years and above are charged the adult price.

  • Children aged from five to nine years are charged fifty percent of the adult price.

  • Children under five years old are free of charge.

Age is determined by year of birth.

PAYMENT POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date or on the tour day.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • A deposit of fifty percent of the total tour value is required at the time of booking.

  • The remaining balance must be paid no later than one day before the tour date.

CANCELLATION POLICY

For groups of one to five guests:

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

For groups of six guests or more:

  • Cancellation two days before the tour date: no cancellation fee.

  • Cancellation one day before the tour date: fifty percent of the tour value will be charged.

  • Cancellation on the tour date: one hundred percent of the tour value will be charged.

Weather-related cancellations for beach tours:

  • If the Port Authority does not allow the tour to operate, Vietlook Travel will cancel the tour and provide a full refund.

  • If the Port Authority allows the tour to proceed and guests choose to cancel, no refund will be provided.

TIPS FOR GUESTS

What to Bring

  • Towels

  • Environmentally friendly sunscreen

  • Change of clothes and swimwear

  • Comfortable shoes or flip-flops

  • Personal necessities

  • Essential items for children, if traveling with kids

Vietlook Travel and its staff are not responsible for any lost, misplaced, or stolen items.

HEALTH AND SAFETY NOTICE

  • This tour is not recommended for guests with limited mobility or wheelchair users.

  • Pregnant women and elderly guests should consult a doctor before joining the tour.

Vietlook Travel is not responsible or liable for any health-related issues that may occur during or after the tour.
